books.title: Dune
books.subtitle: Epic science fiction: politics, ecology, and prophecy on the desert world Arrakis.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: House Atreides is ordered to take control of Arrakis, the only source of the universe’s most valuable substance: spice melange.
Paul Atreides must survive betrayal and desert storms as ancient forces awaken around him.

books.label: Classic

books.title: The Hobbit
books.subtitle: A cozy fantasy adventure from the Shire to the Lonely Mountain.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: Bilbo Baggins is swept into a quest with thirteen dwarves and the wizard Gandalf to reclaim a kingdom from the dragon Smaug.
Tolkien’s tale blends humour, courage, and mythic landscapes that define modern fantasy.

books.label: Classic

books.title: Neuromancer
books.subtitle: Cyberpunk cornerstone: hackers, AIs, and corporate power in the Sprawl.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: Case, a washed-up console cowboy, is offered one last job that pulls him into a conspiracy woven by an enigmatic AI.
Gibson’s prose defined the texture of high-tech, low-life futures for generations of readers.

books.label: Cyberpunk

books.title: Gone Girl
books.subtitle: A marriage thriller where media narratives and private truths violently collide.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: On the morning of their fifth anniversary, Amy Dunne disappears—and suspicion falls on her husband Nick.
Flynn alternates voices to expose manipulation, performance, and the cost of a perfect public image.

books.label: Bestseller

books.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
books.subtitle: Sherlock Holmes investigates a family curse on the Devonshire moor.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: Holmes and Watson untangle rumours of a supernatural hound haunting the Baskerville line.
Atmospheric moors and tight deduction make this one of the most celebrated detective novels.

books.label: Classic

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.subtitle: A sharp comedy of manners about love, class, and mistaken first impressions.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: Elizabeth Bennet navigates society’s expectations while clashing—and eventually connecting—with the proud Mr Darcy.
Austen’s dialogue and irony remain a gold standard for character-driven romance.

books.label: Classic

books.title: It
books.subtitle: Childhood trauma and an ancient evil resurfacing in small-town Maine.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: The Losers Club confronts a shape-shifting predator that feeds on fear—often appearing as a clown.
King interweaves past and present to explore memory, friendship, and what it costs to face the dark.

books.label: Horror Classic

books.title: The Name of the Rose
books.subtitle: A medieval mystery of forbidden books and murders in a Benedictine abbey.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: Brother William of Baskerville arrives to debate theology—and ends up investigating a series of bizarre deaths.
Eco layers semiotics, history, and detective fiction into a labyrinthine library of ideas.

books.label: Historical Mystery

books.title: The Shining
books.subtitle: Isolation, alcoholism, and a hotel that remembers every cruel winter.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: Jack Torrance takes a winter caretaker job at the Overlook Hotel, bringing his wife Wendy and psychic son Danny.
As the snow seals them in, the hotel’s history presses against Jack’s fragile sobriety.

books.label: Horror Classic

books.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
books.subtitle: A journalist and a hacker probe a decades-old disappearance in a powerful Swedish family.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: Mikael Blomkvist teams up with Lisbeth Salander to crack a cold case buried under corporate secrecy.
Larsson’s Millennium series blends procedural detail with blistering social critique.

books.label: Nordic Noir

books.subtitle: A dystopian novel of surveillance, propaganda, and the politics of truth.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: Winston Smith works rewriting history for the Party, until a forbidden love and doubt crack his obedience.
Orwell’s terms—Big Brother, thoughtcrime, Newspeak—entered the global vocabulary.

books.label: Classic

books.title: The Martian
books.subtitle: Stranded on Mars, an engineer survives with science, duct tape, and stubborn optimism.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: Mark Watney is left behind by his crew after a dust storm; he must farm potatoes and jury-rig communications.
Weir’s debut celebrates problem-solving under impossible odds with humour and rigour.

books.label: Science Fiction

books.title: The Fellowship of the Ring
books.subtitle: The first volume of The Lord of the Rings: a ring of power and a fellowship formed.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: Frodo Baggins inherits a ring that darkens the world; a fellowship sets out to destroy it.
From the Shire to Moria, Tolkien expands his legendarium with epic scope and intimate courage.

books.label: Epic Fantasy

books.title: Dracula
books.subtitle: Victorian Gothic horror told through letters, journals, and ship logs.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: Jonathan Harker’s Transylvanian journey introduces Count Dracula, whose hunger reaches England.
Stoker’s collage narrative helped codify the modern vampire for literature and film.

books.label: Gothic Classic

books.title: The Da Vinci Code
books.subtitle: A symbologist and a cryptologist race through Europe decoding a secret protected for centuries.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: Robert Langdon is pulled into a murder investigation at the Louvre that spirals into conspiracy and history.
Brown’s pacing and puzzles made this one of the best-selling mysteries of its era.

books.label: Bestseller

books.title: The Big Sleep
books.subtitle: Hardboiled Los Angeles: blackmail, missing daughters, and Philip Marlowe’s code.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: Private detective Philip Marlowe is hired by General Sternwood—and walks into a maze of vice and violence.
Chandler’s voice rewrote what crime prose could sound like on the page.

books.label: Hardboiled Classic

books.title: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
books.subtitle: Bounty hunting androids in a ruined Earth—and questioning what empathy really means.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: Rick Deckard tracks escaped Nexus-6 androids while craving a real animal in a dying ecosystem.
Dick’s themes of authenticity and compassion inspired generations of philosophical SF.

books.label: Science Fiction

books.title: The Great Gatsby
books.subtitle: Jazz Age glamour, longing, and the American dream refracted through one summer on Long Island.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: Nick Carraway becomes drawn into the orbit of Jay Gatsby, whose parties mask an obsessive love for Daisy Buchanan.
Fitzgerald’s prose captures aspiration, illusion, and the ache beneath the glitter.

books.label: Classic

books.title: The Andromeda Strain
books.subtitle: A techno-thriller about a satellite-borne organism and a secret lab racing to contain it.

blocks.title: About this book
paragraphs: After a small town dies almost overnight, scientists isolate an extraterrestrial microorganism code-named Andromeda.
Crichton’s clinical detail and ticking-clock structure defined the modern outbreak thriller.

books.label: Techno-thriller
